prompt: Prompt for a cinematic scrollytelling site that launches our new water bottle. I have not decided the name or price and have no assets.
output:
## Direction
**Model:** M1 Pinned scene story
**Look:** Gallery Dark
**Stack:** Tier 1 standalone HTML/CSS/JS
**Motion craft:** Weighted response, Masked line reveal, Scale hand-over
**Why:** A pinned scene story suits a product launch with no video or 3D assets by turning one drawn water bottle silhouette into three distinct scroll-driven compositions. Gallery Dark gives a calm, high-contrast launch stage in a single standalone `index.html` with no external libraries.

## Scene plan
| # | Scroll | On screen | Motion | Still version |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0-33% | Whole bottle beside the subject and name slot | Bottle holds steady in the opening dark frame | Bottle beside the subject and name |
| 2 | 33-67% | Close-up on the cap and neck collar on an inverted light field | Bottle zooms and rotates toward the cap as the field inverts | Close-up of the cap beside the subject |
| 3 | 67-100% | Whole bottle above the centred subject and name slot | Bottle pulls back to upright with the cap lifted as the field returns dark | Whole bottle above the subject and name |

## Prompt
```text
GOAL: Launch scrollytelling page for a new water bottle, guiding visitors to understand the subject and remember it at the closing lockup. One index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no libraries; a Google Fonts link is allowed.
CONTENT: Scene 1: "A new water bottle." and [ADD: name]. Scene 2: "A new water bottle.". Scene 3: "A new water bottle." and [ADD: name]. Add no other words or facts. Omit any [ADD: ...] slot completely (never invent a replacement name, subtitle, chapter title, or placeholder essay prose to fill a slot), and report it.
SCENES: Track 450vh. All percentages are of the whole track, from one progress value.
Motif: A water bottle silhouette recognisable with no label: (a) a tall cylindrical body with gently tapered shoulders and a rounded base in --motif-body (#F1ECE4 on dark, #11100F on light); (b) 1 screw cap centred on top, 1 narrow neck collar below the cap, 1 carry loop attached to the side of the cap, and 1 shoulder taper joining neck to body; (c) 2 vertical highlight bands along the left flank in --motif-highlight (#FFFFFF on dark, #3A3530 on light) and 1 horizontal seam ring on the neck collar in --motif-accent (#D6A45C).
Draw it with care as one inline SVG: closed, filled, curved paths in at least three distinct palette hex tones (main body, lighter highlight, accent detail — bound to CSS variables inheriting each section/scene's theme, never a hardcoded dark fill) with a tight viewBox. No stick lines and no bare circles or rectangles standing in for the object. Whenever a scene or inverted band turns dark, update those CSS variables so dark SVG fills switch to light hex tones and every part stays clear across every scene.
Scene 1 | 0-33% | motif left, centre 50%/50% of its box, whole bottle at scale 1, upright 0deg, ground #11100F | whole bottle holds steady at scale 1 and 0deg from 0-26% | text visible at 0%, hold 0-26, out 26-32
Scene 2 | 33-67% | motif right, centre 52%/28% of its box, close-up at scale 2.1 on the cap and neck collar, rotated -6deg, field inverted #F1ECE4 | whole bottle scale 1 -> 2.1 toward its cap and rotate 0 -> -6deg at 26-40%, carry loop pivots 0 -> 18deg, field swaps #11100F -> #F1ECE4 at 32-34% | text in 34-40, hold 40-60, out 60-66
Scene 3 | 67-100% | motif centred in top 64% box, whole bottle at scale 1, upright 0deg, cap lifted, ground #11100F | whole bottle scale 2.1 -> 1 and rotate -6 -> 0deg at 60-74%, cap translates y 0 -> -14% and carry loop settles 18 -> 0deg, field swaps #F1ECE4 -> #11100F at 66-68% | text in 68-74, hold 74-100
MOTION: p = clamp(-track.getBoundingClientRect().top / (track.offsetHeight - stage.offsetHeight), 0, 1). One track, one position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh stage, no ancestor with overflow hidden.
Smooth with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Every value is a pure function of drawn, so scrolling back reverses it.
Animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) inside each range. Never prevent or replace native scroll.
Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%. Outgoing text is at opacity 0 before incoming text appears. The motif stays visible through every hand-over.
LOOK: Ground #11100F, text #F1ECE4, accent #D6A45C (shapes only, never text on inverted field); inverted field swaps ground #F1ECE4 and text #11100F; display Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif; body Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene, also a category or subject line, is display type: scale down cleanly inside 40% desktop columns or mobile frames so the longest word fits inside its container with at least 24px margin and zero right-edge clipping, and never under 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the stage and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, single motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner .copy/.mask elements stay at opacity 1 (never leaving Scene 1 hidden at p = 0); at p = 0 the stage starts in Scene 1's opening ground (never inverted at rest), and when a later scene inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited root/stage CSS variables at every breakpoint (>= 4.5:1 contrast; never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries). Line height 1.05 for display, 1.5 for body, mask padding 0.1em.
LAYOUT: The motif lives in one persistent stage-bound centred box (overflow hidden; min-height 0; min-width 0; z-index 1) with overflow-x clip on the stage (never stack duplicate scene SVGs in the sticky stage). At scale 1 the whole silhouette fits inside that box (SVG max-width 85% and max-height 85%, width/height auto, aspect ratio preserved) so nothing clips below the fold at 0% or 100%; draw one unified single-SVG motif (never floating disconnected halves) and animate transform only on the inner graphic, never scale the box itself.
At 1440x900, before the last scene, place the motif box (width 60%, height 100%, overflow hidden) and the text column (width 40%, vertically centred) side by side in separate non-overlapping regions so the motif never bleeds behind text. Scene 1: motif left, text right; Scene 2: motif right, text left.
The last scene is a centred closing lockup, unlike the first: use a two-row grid or flex column of top 64% (minmax(0, 64%), overflow hidden) above bottom 36% (minmax(0, 36%)) at full width so the entire SVG motif stays inside the top 64% box and never shares space with or covers the closing name centred in the bottom 36%.
At 390x844 and 360x640 the box is top 0 to 45% of the stage in every scene and text sits between 52% and 94%, with 24px gutters, centred in the last scene. Text and motif never overlap, nothing is clipped, nothing scrolls sideways; shrink the display size until the longest line fits.
ASSETS: None: draw everything in SVG and CSS. No stock, generated or placeholder media.
FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order, every word visible at opacity 1, sticky stage/track hidden (display none) until active, compact auto-height static sections (no 100svh spacer above text) above the fold with zero overlap; and when the active stage class IS set, hide the static fallback container (display none) so static copy never shows behind or beneath the stage. Keep keyboard scene-jump links visually hidden until focused (:focus-visible) unless a top navbar was requested, so only the active scene copy is shown at rest. JavaScript adds the class that turns on the stage only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce, switches live when that changes, and removes it if setup throws.
Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Failed media shows the poster or the drawn still with the text intact; waiting over 300ms shows the poster or a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.
AVOID: sections that look like stacked template blocks while motion is on, scroll progress bars, decorative loading bars, card grids, glowing borders, neon or purple-blue gradients, pill badges, text on top of media, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, invented statistics, testimonials, logos, and stock media.
DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% on 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640 the screen matches SCENES, with no overlapping text, empty screen, sideways scroll or console error.
Reduced motion and no JavaScript show every word. Tab shows each link in view. Reload at 50% draws the 50% state. Report each check as passed, failed or not run.
```
